metadata.title: Welcome to DOS AI Explained: AI, Made Simple
metadata.description:
AI is changing everything - but almost nobody explains it simply. DOS AI Explained turns big AI ideas into clear, useful, fact-checked videos for curious beginners, students, creators and professionals.

What we cover:
- AI tools, reviewed honestly
- How AI actually works, from chatbots to agents
- Tech news, explained
- Practical how-tos to put AI to work

New Shorts every day and a deep-dive video every week. First deep dive: How AI Agents Actually Work.

Subscribe: https://www.youtube.com/@DOSAIExplained?sub_confirmation=1

Narration uses an AI voice and the visuals are AI-generated 3D art and code-made graphics; research and script by DOS AI Explained.

#AIExplained #ArtificialIntelligence #DOSAIExplained

script: AI is changing everything. But almost nobody explains it simply.
